changelog:
cad-to-data 2.0.0

- Major update: New data structures and extraction logic for structured extraction from CAD/BIM files.
- Expanded support for multiple formats: Revit, IFC, DWG, DGN, plus new formats (DXF, NWD, STEP).
- Introduced detailed dataclasses for elements, materials, layers, and results.
- Defines granular element categories (wall, floor, roof, etc.).
- Implements a simulated IFC extraction workflow as a reference.
- Includes Quick Start code and documentation updates.
summary: Convert CAD/BIM files to structured data. Extract element data from Revit, IFC, DWG, DGN files.
